**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

- **Searched independently** for liquidated damages, penalties, forfeiture, minimum/termination fees — no responsive language anywhere in the document.
- **Termination architecture confirms it:** §12.3 lets AbbVie terminate for any or no reason on 90 days' notice with **no exit payment**; §§12.6–12.8 impose only reversion/transfer/licence-back consequences; §12.9 preserves ordinary law-and-equity remedies rather than a stipulated sum; §12.10.1 survives Article 6 only for **accrued** milestone/Net Sales amounts.
- **§6.10 late-payment interest** is mutual ("either Party", running against Harpoon too) and is ordinary default interest, not a Customer-only penalty — not an LD deviation, though the rate is redacted ([***]).
- **§6.15** ("No Other Compensation") reinforces that the stated terms fully define all consideration payable between the Parties.

No redline proposed — the absence of any Customer-payable liquidated amount already satisfies the preferred element, so there is nothing to cap under the fallback.
